_disclaimer: These thresholds are DATASET-RELATIVE, derived from the 33rd and 67th percentiles of the synthetic dummy dataset. They are NOT validated engineering safety limits or certified EMC compliance thresholds. Do not use for engineering sign-off.

Victim_Voltage_V.description: Predicted induced voltage on victim cable

Victim_RMS_V.description: Predicted RMS value of induced victim voltage

risk_scoring._note: Risk indicators are computed per target independently. No single composite score is forced because the targets are correlated — combining them would double-count shared variance. Each target receives a normalised 0-1 indicator. A composite summary is shown for orientation only.

geometry_modifiers.separation_description: Separation below 30 mm is considered geometrically compact in this dataset context.
geometry_modifiers.overlap_description: Overlap above 350 mm is considered geometrically extensive in this dataset context.

model_reliability._note: If model R2 < 0.60 for a target, a reliability warning is appended to the explanation. RMSE as a fraction of the prediction value > 30% also triggers a caution.
